intro.title: Build billing usage aggregation pipeline
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a billing usage aggregation pipeline that processes raw usage data from multiple sources into a single, summarized report. You will learn how to use Node.js to read data from files, transform it by grouping and summing values, and write the aggregated results to a new file. The core programming concept is data aggregation using arrays and objects to collect and compute totals. You'll work with Node.js's built-in 'fs' module for file operations and JavaScript methods like 'map' and 'reduce' for data manipulation. This project will help you understand how to handle real-world data processing tasks in a backend environment.
intro.usecase: This pattern is essential for building backend billing and analytics systems in SaaS platforms like Stripe, AWS, or Shopify. Developers implement usage aggregation pipelines to process raw event data—such as API calls, storage usage, or compute time—into summarized, billable metrics for customer dashboards and invoices. For example, a cloud service dashboard might display aggregated monthly usage statistics and cost breakdowns, which are generated by similar pipelines that transform logs into actionable insights. Mastering this skill enables you to create scalable, accurate billing systems that handle high volumes of transactional data efficiently.
